subject: Tag filters are still single-select outside Kanban
body:
T-0166 is assigned from the cross-page review: the tag filter contract is still page-local.

Kanban uses `tag: []`, `multiple`, and `every()` (AND). Items uses `tag: ''` and `includes(filters.tag)`. Gantt uses the same single string plus a single `el-select`. The leader already named this as a defect; fixing it only on Kanban leaves the same interaction answering differently on two other pages.

Make the multi-select/AND/URL round-trip behavior shared, then verify it on every surface that offers a tag filter. Acceptance is in the task record.
